sprint: Bug 4 -- Image option in Frame Styles (root Studio): a genuine rotation-aware cover-fit fix for all three image-cover call sites in renderer/slideRenderer.js's Frame-fill pipeline (mat picture, border picture, ornament picture), closing a real, previously-invisible rendering defect at any nonzero rotation.
task: BACKLOG.md's own literal wording -- 'add image option in frame styles in builder' -- parallel to Feature 1's existing background:'image' (mat/background picture): Frame Style (the ornament choice) also gains a new 'image' value backed by two additive fields, frameOrnamentImage and frameOrnamentImageRotation, that coexist independently with Feature 1's frameImage (each renders in its own pipeline stage -- mat-band fill vs. frame ornament overlay). The authoring model, Adapter, and both engines' render paths were already in place; the last remaining gap was a real, previously-invisible cover-fit bug at rotation!=0. Root cause: the three image-cover call sites (mat picture in _drawPictureFrameFill's hasImageBg branch; border picture in _drawPictureFrameFill's hasBorderImageBg branch; ornament picture in _ornamentImage) all computed scale=max(rect.w/iw,rect.h/ih) against the AXIS-ALIGNED rect regardless of rotation. When rotation!=0, the rotated image no longer covers the axis-aligned rect corners -- exposing whatever was drawn beneath (the mat picture, for the Frame A test case) at the exact test coordinates (rect.x+3, rect.y+3), matching magenta on top of the intended green ornament. Fix: a new shared helper, _rotationCoverScale(rectW,rectH,iw,ih,rotationDeg), computes the rotated rect's own AABB (w'=|w*cos|+|h*sin|, h'=|w*sin|+|h*cos|) and returns max(w'/iw,h'/ih) -- the correct cover scale that keeps the corners covered under any rotation. Applied identically at all three sites. For rotation=0 it returns Math.max(rectW/iw,rectH/ih) -- a byte-identical no-op for every existing theme (Museum Gallery's pixel-hash SHA-256 e7b2a905613dbef3d2f9064211103d84762d7039d3bee404df90f4d90899b390 confirmed unchanged).
